**No material findings in `41f0b5ce`.** All four fixes close their original findings, and I found no new acceptance bypass or valid-history refusal. There are no severity-ranked defects to report.

1. **`shiploop_navigator.py:finish_improve` — the new gate has the required state and preserves valid imports.**  
   The call runs after canonicalization and before `_apply_result` records acceptance. The parent still points at the reviewed stage and work item; its history still contains the send-back, previous plan, and previous specification. `validate` also checks that the child matches the current parent action. See [finish_improve — check placement and replay handling](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/.claude/worktrees/fix-forward-5308ed/skills/shiploop/scripts/shiploop_navigator.py:4462).

   **Verified history:** S1 completes; S2 sends back; an amendment retains S1. An Improve result dropping S1’s mark is refused, as is one changing C1’s frozen definition. Changing only S2’s pending task imports successfully and resumes with one built step.

   Valid replay returns before the new gate. I completed the synthetic run through its outer stages, then replayed the accepted amendment with `_check_fix_forward` patched to raise if called: replay succeeded unchanged. Actual pure-state document and outer-stage Improve imports also succeeded. The helper exits for unrelated stages and non-`done` outcomes before looking up the current item.

   Stopped-child settlement remains separate: dispatch calls `settle_incomplete` and `reconcile`, bypassing `finish_improve`. I verified that path by code tracing; the new call cannot interfere with it. See [dispatch — stopped-child settlement](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/.claude/worktrees/fix-forward-5308ed/skills/shiploop/scripts/shiploop_navigator.py:10258).

2. **`shiploop_navigator.py:_frozen_case_refusal` — omission now protects frozen cases.**  
   An omitted list compares as empty, so it cannot remove TC-1. A malformed supplied list still reaches shape validation. See [_frozen_case_refusal — omitted-list handling](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/.claude/worktrees/fix-forward-5308ed/skills/shiploop/scripts/shiploop_navigator.py:3071).

   **Verified history:** after the retained-S1 amendment, omission and explicit `[]` both refuse removal of TC-1. Changing TC-1’s oracle or adding a new case due at S1 is refused. Keeping the cases unchanged, or adding a case due at unfinished S2, passes. Explicit `null` also fails canonical shape validation.

3. **`shiploop_test_loop.py:accepted_counts` — retained counts neither accumulate twice nor depend on read order.**  
   The added actions come from the requested item’s retained per-step projection and must precede the newest plan. `dict.fromkeys` removes duplicates; `_most` takes a maximum, not a sum. Although retained records are grouped by stage, `earlier_steps` computes its cutoff from chronological history before that grouping. See [accepted_counts — selection, cutoff, and maximum](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/.claude/worktrees/fix-forward-5308ed/skills/shiploop/scripts/shiploop_test_loop.py:1078).

   **Verified history:** S1’s maximum is 55; interrupted S2 records contain 500 and 900; another item contains 10,000. After amendment, both count readers return 55. One new ID raises the resumed floor to 56. Once the current step accepts 56, its floor remains 56, not 57. A second amendment retains two completed steps’ maximum of 58 while excluding interrupted records of 5,000 and 9,000. An unmarked plan resets the counts.

   **Existing interim behavior:** immediately after send-back, before the replacement plan is accepted, the reader still scans the old plan’s suffix and can report the interrupted count. I reproduced 900 there, followed by 55 after amendment. This is outside resumed test execution and does not reopen the floor defect.

4. **`shiploop_navigator.py:_check_step_sizing` — false `done` marks cannot authorize the exemption.**  
   Sizing skips the criteria requirement for marked rows, but fix-forward checks **every** marked row against exactly the completed prefix, then compares those rows with their accepted versions. See [_fix_forward_refusal — complete mark-set and prefix checks](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/.claude/worktrees/fix-forward-5308ed/skills/shiploop/scripts/shiploop_navigator.py:3012).

   **Verified histories:** criterion-free completed S1 survives an amendment introducing C2 for S2; unfinished S2 with empty criteria still fails sizing. I checked all eight mark combinations across three rows in both fresh and retained-S1 histories—16 combinations total. Only the authorized prefix passes. A forged frozen row with unknown criteria fails row equality; malformed marks fail canonicalization even when the helper defers shape errors.

Verification used read-only tracing and in-memory Python probes, with test-record I/O mocked. I did not run the CLI/E2E suites or change files.
